tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Do Automation Benefits Outweigh Its Drawbacks
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Diaz
professor.text: We've been discussing the impact of automation on the labor market. Because it removes or reduces the human element, automation can increase efficiency and reduce costs, but it can also lead to job displacement and changes in employment patterns. Do you think the benefits of automation outweigh the drawbacks? Why or why not?

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: The benefits of automation outweigh the drawbacks. It can increase efficiency and reduce costs for businesses, leading to economic growth. While it may displace some jobs, it also creates new opportunities in technology and maintenance to compensate for job losses in other sectors.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: The drawbacks of automation are significant. Job displacement can lead to unemployment, social issues, economic downturns and a host of other problems. The focus should be on retraining workers and creating new job opportunities to mitigate these negative effects.
